direction: An editorial field atlas with warm ivory planes, graphite typography, a restrained green signal color, and a flexible branch rail that reveals project examples without collapsing the portfolio into a wall of cards.

references.name: UI Build Reference — Master Index v2

inherited_moves: compose the whole screen before decorating components
use typography by job: display / reading / state labels
use one accent with one semantic meaning
use stronger section rhythm than component rhythm
render work through a functional navigation structure
deliberate_departures: light mineral-paper material instead of the initially shared dark SaaS landing direction
no glassmorphism, aurora gradients, neon rim lighting, or floating stat cards
near-square editorial geometry instead of soft rounded card language
serif display voice paired with sans reading text and mono state labels
branch rail and ledger slices instead of a product-dashboard hero composition
green is reserved for active exploration and live links rather than generic decoration

accent.meaning: active exploration, selected branch, primary navigation signal

tokens.geometry: editorial rectangles, hairlines, almost no radius
tokens.motion: short hover/state transitions only; no continuous motion; reduced-motion respected

validation.V1_identity: PASS — describable as editorial field atlas / ivory switchboard without relying on modern/clean/AI adjectives
validation.V2_hierarchy: PASS — identity, branch navigation, projects, status metadata, research lineage, and resume status have distinct jobs
validation.V3_consistency: PASS — signal green means active/selected/navigation throughout
validation.V5_resilience: PASS BY STATIC REVIEW — responsive breakpoints defined for 980px and 680px; runtime browser smoke still recommended after Pages deployment
